name: Fastest God Alive
description:
For every 1cm traveled, gain 0.05% damage bonus on his next Basic Attack (max 25%).

You also gains additional Strength equal to 25% of Movement Speed from items or abilities.

name: Made You Look
description:
Move in the blink of an eye, dealing Physical Damage to every enemy within a target area.

• This ability can Critically Hit, apply Ability Item effects, and apply Basic Attack item effects

name: Maximum Velocity
description:
Passive: Gain increased Movement Speed.

Active: Gain increased Attack Speed, cleans yourself of Slows, and becomes immune to Slows for the duration.

name: Special Delivery
description: You dash forward. Knock minions aside and deal Physical Damage to them. Grab the first enemy god encountered, spinning them. The enemy god takes Physical Damage every 0.25s until the effect ends. They are then thrown in the direction you are facing.

name: Sonic Boom
description:
Gather energy for a powerful Dash. The range increases as you charge. Dash forward, dealing Physical Damage and spinning enemies hit along the dash.

• Gain Movement Speed for 5s after the dash that scales based on the energy gathered.

name: Mercury Basic Attack
description: Deal Physical Damage to an enemy in front of you.
